add_definitions(
    -D_WINE
    -D_USE_MATH_DEFINES)

spec2def(dsound.dll dsound.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No CONST_VTABLE

# dsound.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dsound-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(dsound_shims OBJECT buffer.c capture.c dsound.c dsound_convert.c dsound_main.c duplex.c mixer.c primary.c propset.c sound3d.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(dsound_shims PRIVATE dxguid uuid wine libwinmm libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(dsound_shims)
add_cargo_module(dsound dsound-cargo dsound.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dsound_shims psdk uuid_sources)
